en.headline: AFCD signs contract for urban farming pilot at Laguna Park in Kwun Tong
en.dek: A 500-square-metre indoor hydroponic farm is scheduled to open in 2027, offering local produce and public farming activities.
body: The Agriculture, Fisheries and Conservation Department on Tuesday signed a contract with the Hong Kong Federation of Youth Groups for a Pilot Project on Urban Farming at Laguna Park in Kwun Tong.

The project will establish a modern indoor crop farm of about 500 square metres using soilless hydroponic technology. It is expected to begin operation in 2027 and will produce salad greens, local leafy vegetables, tomatoes and cucumbers.

In addition to commercial production, the farm will offer guided tours, agri-tech workshops, experiential farming activities and creative bazaars. An AFCD spokesman said the scheme aligns with the government’s Blueprint for the Sustainable Development of Agriculture and Fisheries and follows an earlier pilot in Ma On Shan.
Located beside the Cha Kwo Ling Promenade, the site sits between residential estates and commercial areas in Kwun Tong.

zh.headline: 漁護署與青協簽約 觀塘麗港公園設都市農耕先導項目
zh.dek: 約500平方米室內水耕農場預計2027年運作，提供本地蔬菜及公眾體驗活動。
body: 漁農自然護理署周二與香港青年協會簽署合約，於觀塘麗港公園推行都市農耕先導項目。
項目將設置約500平方米的現代化室內作物農場，採用無土水耕技術，預計2027年投入運作，生產沙律菜、本地葉菜、番茄及青瓜等。
除日常生產外，農場將提供導賞團、農科工作坊、現代化農耕體驗及創意市集。漁護署發言人指項目配合政府的漁農業可持續發展藍圖，繼馬鞍山先導項目後在九龍首度推行。
農場毗鄰茶果嶺海濱長廊，位於觀塘大型住宅及商業區之間。
